cases.title: BAFU's water embodied in product is an output, not a withdrawal
cases.summary: Brightway Flows 1.1.0 places the 5 BAFU rows `Water, embodied in product[, <country>]` (economic issues, kg) on EF 3.1 `water` in Resources, a withdrawal input, at 0.001 m3/kg.

cases.title: BAFU groundwater emissions take EF 3.1's unspecified-water factor in our use
cases.summary: EF 3.1, as the JRC states it, has no factor for BAFU's `groundwater` sub-compartment, and the context carry rules do not carry one into the unconfined aquifer. River and lake take EF fresh water by the upstream rule; for groundwater our use applies the JRC factor for `Emissions to water, unspecified` of the same substance.
cases.reason: Without it, a short-term groundwater emission gets no JRC factor, while the 1.1.0 release links BAFU `Phosphate, emissions to water / groundwater, long-term` to EF 3.1 `Phosphate` (08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-9788-0050c2490048, unspecified water, long-term) and the JRC characterises it at 0.33 in freshwater eutrophication. The release itself is not blank on the aquifer: Brightway Flows 1.1.0, and two other implementations, state 0.33 for phosphate on its short-term groundwater row (68daec3d…, unconfined aquifer), so our rule agrees with the release there. Of the 60 BAFU substances with a groundwater row, the release states a non-JRC factor for 2 in freshwater eutrophication (both equal to the JRC unspecified-water factor), 2 in marine (both equal), 1 in human toxicity cancer (differs), 8 in non-cancer (all differ) and 14 in freshwater ecotoxicity (13 equal, 1 not comparable); the JRC states none. With JRC factors and the upstream river and lake rules alone, freshwater eutrophication on BAFU:2026 drops by a median of 17.6 % against the factors our use applied before this change (11,041 processes move by more than 10 %; wheat IP CH -9.2 %, potatoes IP CH -15.9 %). With groundwater on unspecified water no process moves by 10 % or more, because EF's fresh-water and unspecified-water values for phosphate and phosphorus are equal. In toxicity the groundwater rule moves more processes: ecotoxicity, freshwater 9,624 against 6,278 by more than 10 % (median +16.6 % against +9.5 %), human toxicity non-cancer 5,909 against 5,202, cancer 4,845 against 4,434. Counted over 12,074 processes: the 11,947 BAFU:2026 ecoSpold datasets plus 127 regional copies of water-using datasets made in our import. 5,165 groundwater exchanges are in scope, beside 18,218 river and 1,969 lake.

evidence.label: Context carry rules for river and lake; nothing carried into the aquifer
evidence.note: Downward rules for River and Lake; the description names the unconfined aquifer among the contexts not carried into.

evidence.label: Release rows, exchanges in scope and effect on BAFU:2026
evidence.note: Counts and supply-weighted shares only; no dataset amounts.

cases.next_action: Keep the application policy named and disclosed. Where the release states a different aquifer value (8 non-cancer rows, 1 cancer), our use follows the JRC unspecified-water factor; whether the aquifer should carry unspecified water's number for every method is the carry rules' question, and it is not proposed upstream.
cases.disposition: Our use: groundwater takes the JRC factor for EF 3.1 'water, unspecified', a disclosed application policy. Upstream: not proposed.
